item.description: The Port St. Lucie City Council voted unanimously Monday to rezone a residential lot behind the home of Margaret and Joseph Mucciolo to commercial use, despite the couple's months-long opposition. item.title: Florida voters say rising insurance costs will drive them to vote in 2026 midterms
item.description: A new study shows 65% of Florida respondents say rising insurance costs would make them more likely to vote in the 2026 midterm elections, as homeowners insurance becomes a key political issue.

item.title: Fort Pierce planning board reviews Causeway Cove high-rise proposal that would exceed city height limits
item.description: The Fort Pierce Planning Board reviewed the Causeway Cove development project on Monday, a proposal that includes five high-rise buildings off Seaway Drive, with the tallest standing 17 stories and 192 feet tall. item.title: Rising home insurance costs driving voter turnout in Florida midterm elections, study finds
item.description: A new study from Insurify found that 65% of Florida respondents said rising insurance costs would make them more likely to vote in the 2026 midterms.

item.title: World Cup semifinals set with England facing Argentina and Spain meeting France
item.description: England and Argentina advanced to the World Cup semifinals after weekend quarterfinal victories over Norway and Switzerland, completing the final four along with France and Spain.

item.title: Linda Noskova wins Wimbledon after recovering from blown match points in all-Czech final
item.description: Linda Noskova overcame Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 on Saturday to win her first Grand Slam trophy, becoming the third Czech woman in four years to win Wimbledon.

item.title: Jannik Sinner beats Alexander Zverev to win second consecutive Wimbledon title
item.description: Top-ranked Jannik Sinner defeated Alexander Zverev 6-7, 7-6, 6-3, 6-4 on Sunday at the All England Club for his fifth Grand Slam title and second straight Wimbledon championship.

item.title: Florida Democrats point to special-election wins, target Republican supermajorities in 2026
item.description: Florida Democrats say recent special-election victories prove they can break Republican supermajorities in the state Legislature in 2026. item.title: Rising insurance costs emerge as key Florida midterm election issue, study finds
item.description: A new study shows 65% of Florida voters say rising insurance costs are making them more likely to vote in the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Florida man loses roof to Hurricane Milton months after paying off home, faces bills without insurance
item.description: A Florida homeowner paid off his house only to have Hurricane Milton tear off his roof two months later, leaving him to cover repair costs without home insurance.

item.title: Port St. Lucie couple fights city council rezoning of lot behind their home
item.description: Joseph and Margaret Mucciolo say Port St. Lucie City Council voted unanimously to rezone the lot behind their home from residential to commercial, despite their months-long opposition.

item.title: Fire crews extinguish pickup truck fire on Florida's Turnpike in St. Lucie County
item.description: St. Lucie County Fire District crews responded to a vehicle fire Monday morning on Florida's Turnpike Northbound near Mile Marker 175.

item.title: Port St. Lucie Opens Registration for Free City University Program
item.description:

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to panoramic views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, offers visitors a 105-step climb to panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.
